paper: FinPos: A Position-Aware Trading Agent System for Real Financial Markets
claim_boundary: A researcher-authored monthly U.S.-stock implementation of FinPos's hierarchical signal memory, separate Direction and Quantity/Risk decisions, carried position state, multi-timescale delayed reward, and CVaR exposure cap; not a native GPT-4o FinPos policy or share ledger.

primary_source_anchors.mechanism: Unlike independent one-step actions, FinPos carries the current position across decisions so earlier exposure affects subsequent risk and return.
Two-level signal-processing and analysis agents place volatile information in shallow memory and repeatedly validated long-horizon information in deeper memory.
A Direction Agent selects sell/hold/buy strategic intent, then a distinct Quantity/Risk Agent chooses the position change conditional on the carried position and CVaR.
Future 1/7/30-day trends create a training-only multi-timescale reward that supports later reflection but is never available to the live decision.

position_policy.quantity_rule: move carried position by at most 0.25 times direction confidence and never beyond risk-budget divided by absolute 5% CVaR, clipped to 0.25 through 1.00
position_policy.stale_position_rule: reset a security position to zero after any absence from the monthly formation universe
position_policy.common_portfolio_adapter: the carried security-level position score enters frozen value-weighted long-short deciles and all six cost/missing-return paths

preserved_elements: position update as prior position plus direction times quantity
separate Direction and Quantity/Risk decision stages
sell, hold, and buy direction semantics
hierarchical shallow, middle, and deep signal memory
short-, medium-, and long-horizon reward components
delayed reflection only after future outcomes realize
approximated_elements: JKP surprises and attention replace news filtering agents
JKP momentum and volatility replace daily price-analysis agents
JKP value and quality replace filing-analysis agents
rolling multi-horizon RankIC reliability replaces LLM reflection and memory migration
continuous normalized position replaces integer shares
historical monthly return CVaR replaces daily account-PnL CVaR
the common decile portfolio replaces the native single-asset account ledger
invented_elements: the 60-month reflection history and softmax temperature
the 5% risk budget and 0.25/1.00 position-cap bounds
